title: Suppressor of cytokine signaling 1 haploinsufficiency in a patient with granulomatous lymphocytic interstitial lung disease and inflammatory bowel disease-like disease.
authors: Sonmez, Gamze; Yaz, Ismail; Ustun, Ceren; Sahin, Ali; Aliyeva, Gulnar; Babaoglu, Elif; Ozden, Guzin; Halacli, Sevil Oskay; Cagdas, Deniz
one_liner_zh: 该文报道SOCS1单倍剂量不足病例，涉及STAT1信号通路和AlphaFold3结构预测，但核心是临床免疫表型而非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，方法仅辅助诊断，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Suppressor of cytokine signaling 1 (SOCS1) haploinsufficiency is an inborn error of immunity with dysregulated Janus kinase (JAK)-signal transducer and activator of transcription (STAT) signaling and heterogeneous autoimmune, infectious, and inflammatory phenotypes; its spectrum and management remain unclear. We report a 29-year-old woman with a novel heterozygous SOCS1 variant (c.494C>T; p.Pro165Arg) identified by whole-exome sequencing. Variant impact was assessed in silico (combined annotation dependent depletion, conservation mapping, AlphaFold3, and PremPS) and functionally by measuring total and phosphorylated STAT1 (p-STAT1) expression in patient vs control cells at baseline and after interferon-gamma stimulation. We also reviewed data from 20 previously reported SOCS1-deficient patients. The patient had granulomatous lymphocytic interstitial lung disease (GLILD), rheumatoid arthritis, inflammatory bowel disease-like enteropathy, and hypogammaglobulinemia, initially diagnosed with common variable immune deficiency. GLILD responded to rituximab; sirolimus was ineffective for enteropathy. Segregation revealed an asymptomatic father carrying the same variant. The patient was found to have an additional heterozygous TACI gene variant. Poststimulation flow cytometry showed higher STAT1 [24.7 vs 5.8 median fluorescence intensity (MFI)] and p-STAT1 (43.4 vs 2.4 MFI) levels; however, these differences were not statistically significant (P > 0.05). Structural modeling predicted Src homology 2 domain destabilization (DeltaDeltaG + 1.16 kcal/mol). Literature synthesis for SOCS1 deficiency patients (n = 21) showed median symptom onset of 8 years (range 5 months to 44 years), autoimmune diseases (immune thrombocytopenia, psoriasis, etc.), and frequent immunophenotypic abnormalities: lymphopenia 4/8 (50%); high IgE 5/7 (71.4%); low CD3+ 11/17 (64.7%); CD4+ 6/19 (31.5%); CD8+ 5/17 (29.4%); B cells 5/17 (29.4%); and natural killer (NK) cells 4/19 (21%). SOCS1 haploinsufficiency presents heterogeneous phenotypes with variable penetrance. Early genetic testing and targeted interventions, such as JAK inhibitors or cytokine-blocking biologics, may improve outcomes.
abstract_zh: 细胞因子信号传导抑制因子1（SOCS1）单倍剂量不足是一种先天性免疫错误，伴有Janus激酶（JAK）-信号转导及转录激活因子（STAT）信号通路失调，以及异质性自身免疫、感染和炎症表型；其疾病谱和管理仍不明确。我们报告一例29岁女性患者，通过全外显子组测序发现一种新的杂合SOCS1变异（c.494C>T；p.Pro165Arg）。变异影响通过计算机模拟（联合注释依赖性缺失、保守性映射、AlphaFold3和PremPS）及功能实验评估，即在基线和干扰素-γ刺激后，测量患者与对照细胞中总STAT1和磷酸化STAT1（p-STAT1）的表达。我们还回顾了20例既往报道的SOCS1缺陷患者数据。该患者患有肉芽肿性淋巴细胞性间质性肺病（GLILD）、类风湿关节炎、炎症性肠病样肠病和低丙种球蛋白血症，最初诊断为常见变异型免疫缺陷病。GLILD对利妥昔单抗有反应；西罗莫司对肠病无效。家系分离分析显示，其无症状父亲携带相同变异。该患者还发现携带额外的杂合TACI基因变异。刺激后流式细胞术显示STAT1水平较高[24.7 vs 5.8中位荧光强度（MFI）]和p-STAT1水平较高（43.4 vs 2.4 MFI）；然而，这些差异无统计学显著性（P > 0.05）。结构建模预测Src同源2结构域不稳定（DeltaDeltaG + 1.16 kcal/mol）。对SOCS1缺陷患者（n = 21）的文献综合分析显示，症状发作中位年龄为8岁（范围5个月至44岁），常见自身免疫病（免疫性血小板减少症、银屑病等），以及频繁的免疫表型异常：淋巴细胞减少4/8（50%）；高IgE 5/7（71.4%）；低CD3+ 11/17（64.7%）；CD4+ 6/19（31.5%）；CD8+ 5/17（29.4%）；B细胞5/17（29.4%）；自然杀伤（NK）细胞4/19（21%）。SOCS1单倍剂量不足呈现异质性表型，外显率可变。早期基因检测和靶向干预，如JAK抑制剂或细胞因子阻断生物制剂，可能改善预后。
